messages:
maggie: Flag for roadmap: we need a short, enforceable policy for list prices and when Sales can push below public list. Decision needed today for the board deck.

carlos: Proposal: public list prices are our default; discounts require a documented approval ticket and a signed amendment for Dedicated/Private. No backdated overrides.

nina: Agree. Add a simple tiered approval matrix: < $20k ARR -> AE approval; $20k-$200k -> AM + RevOps; > $200k -> RevOps + Legal.

sam: Ops note: Billing must be able to represent both "list" and "effective" price per tenant and export for finance. Need a migration plan for existing custom pricing.

legal-bot: Legal: we can accept the matrix. Recommend 120-day grandfathering on addon removals for enterprise; 45 days for self-serve. Will draft language.

maggie: OK finalise: 1) public list enforced on pricing page; 2) discount matrix above; 3) discounts require ticket + amendment for Dedicated/Private; 4) addon sunset = 120d enterprise / 45d self-serve; 5) billing & console show list vs effective price. Owners: carlos (policy doc), sam (billing + migration), nina (approval matrix + training), legal-bot (clause).

carlos: I'll put up PR for the policy and a small FAQ for Sales.

sam: I'll scope a billing migration ticket and add export fields.

nina: I'll prep the approval forms and a 1-pager.

maggie: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge by EOD and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to walk Sales through the change.

carlos: No objections.

nina: LGTM.

sam: good by me.
